procedure_text: To a clean and pre-dried 100mL round bottomed flask, dichloromethane (10mL) NMSBA (1.0g, 0.004mol) and N, N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide (DCC) (0.8g, 0.004mol) were added under stirring at the temperature of 25-30°C. Tothismixture, 1, 3-cyclohexanedione (0.45g, 0.004mol) was added and stirred for about 2 hours at 25-30°C. The reaction mixture was quenched with water (10mL) and separated the organic layer. The organic layer obtained was concentrated to obtain enol ester as off white crystalline solid. HPLC purity > 85%; Yield: 0.89g (65%); Melting point 152-158°C.
procedure_summary: NMSBA is coupled with 1,3-cyclohexanedione in dichloromethane using dicyclohexylcarbodiimide, which activates the carboxylic acid so that the enol of the dione esterifies it directly, without the acid chloride the prior-art route makes first. The mixture is quenched with water, the organic layer separated and concentrated, and the enol ester is left as an off white crystalline solid.
